name: Musuko no Tame nara Midara ni Nareru Haha
original_name: 息子のためなら淫らになれる母
source:
Yayoi discovers that her neighbor Hikami Sae loves to have sex with younger men. Her next target is Yayoi's son Yuuta. To save her son from being corrupted by Sae she allows herself to be blackmailed by her. Sae brings Yayoi into her own dark world, a world of the pleasures of the flesh.

Again and again Yayoi has sex with an unknown young man all for the sake of her son. Slowly she sinks into a forbidden world before she discovers too late that the boy she's having an affair with is her own son Yuuta.
translation: 弥生发现邻居冰上彩喜欢和年轻男人做爱。她的下一个目标就是弥生的儿子优太。为了保护儿子不被彩腐化，弥生允许自己被她要挟。彩将弥生带入了自己的黑暗世界——一个肉欲的乐园。弥生一次又一次地和一个不认识的年轻男人做爱，全都是为了儿子。她慢慢地沉沦进了一个禁忌的世界，直到为时已晚才发现——和她发生关系的那个男孩正是她自己的儿子雄太。
